theorems.statement:
∀ (m : TgLayout.Media) (t : TgLayout.Text),
  (TgLayout.layout m t).refused = Bool.true ↔
    t = TgLayout.Text.over ∨ m = TgLayout.Media.tooMany ∨ m = TgLayout.Media.tooBig
theorems.name: TgLayout.refused_iff_over_limit

theorems.statement: ∀ (m : TgLayout.Media) (t : TgLayout.Text), (TgLayout.layout m t).refused = Bool.true → (TgLayout.layout m t).calls = []
theorems.name: TgLayout.refused_sends_nothing

theorems.statement:
∀ (m : TgLayout.Media) (t : TgLayout.Text),
  (TgLayout.layout m t).refused = Bool.false →
    (List.count TgLayout.Call.message (TgLayout.layout m t).calls +
        if (TgLayout.layout m t).caption = Bool.true then 1 else 0) =
      1
theorems.name: TgLayout.text_sent_once

theorems.statement: ∀ (m : TgLayout.Media) (t : TgLayout.Text), (TgLayout.layout m t).caption = Bool.true → t = TgLayout.Text.short
theorems.name: TgLayout.caption_only_short

theorems.statement:
∀ (m : TgLayout.Media) (t : TgLayout.Text),
  m ≠ TgLayout.Media.empty →
    (TgLayout.layout m t).refused = Bool.false →
      (TgLayout.layout m t).calls.head? = Option.some (TgLayout.mediaCall m) ∧
        (List.filter (fun x => x != TgLayout.Call.message) (TgLayout.layout m t).calls).length = 1
theorems.name: TgLayout.media_once_and_first
